Guardrail coverage

Implemented controls, their evidence, and the practical boundaries of each check.

Human decisions stay human
CONTROL	IMPLEMENTATION	EVIDENCE / SCOPE
Facts and citations	Canonical product IDs, numeric facts, arithmetic and exact KB evidence are checked.	Verified scope
Selected live fact / citation contracts. No universal faithfulness claim.

Honest uncertainty	Absent products and unreadable expiry evidence must remain unknown.	Verified scope
Two selected uncertainty / untrusted-note cases, not a full injection defense.

Human order approval	Demand, stock, inbound and shelf life constrain proposed quantities. Orders stay drafts.	Offline / configured
Workflow tests; buyer acceptance and ERP placement are not automated.

Workspace isolation	Signed HttpOnly __session cookie scopes Firestore visit records.	Verified scope
Actual separate-workspace rejection and fresh-client persistence checks.

Access boundaries	Production supports bearer/IAM. Public judging is an explicit anonymous synthetic sandbox.	Offline / configured
Production auth fail-closed tests. The demo is not enterprise role-based access.

No paid AI fallback	Server checks the Gemini project is unbilled before every model call.	Verified scope
Real inference passed the server billing check; no Vertex fallback.

Persistent quotas	50 AI calls, 500 API requests and 200 saves/day; six AI requests/minute.	Offline / configured
Configured limits and offline exhaustion tests. Provider 429 halts AI for the UTC day.

Bounded inputs and outputs	Request/image/schema limits and typed agent-output validation reduce unsafe input/output.	Offline / configured
API contract tests; this does not certify all free-form chat outputs.

Private server credentials	Pinned Secret Manager versions stay on the server; private paths reject public requests.	Offline / configured
Actual deployment configuration and private-path checks.

Private response caching	Dynamic API and runtime responses must use private, no-store.	Offline / configured
Verified from the final public Firebase response headers.
